name: Gideon
thought: Elena's right there and Isla's standing three people away. I can't look at her too long, so best I go knead dough at the market and keep my hands and my face busy.

name: Bram
thought: I buried two friends who died in Silas's fields, and I won't keep quiet while the next workers go out there. I'll say it plainly in front of everyone and keep my master key to myself.

name: Caleb
thought: Food costs 8 a night and I have 20 coin, so working is the safe move. I'll say nothing about the stockpile and keep my head down while I read the room.

name: Jasper
thought: Everyone is watching the square, so I'll smile and keep my hands busy. Tomas can wait until he's alone, and the coin I'm owed will still be owed tomorrow.

name: Nell
thought: Father's grain hoard is my weapon, but I need proof and allies before I use it. For now I earn coin so I can feed myself and the children I teach.

name: Silas
thought: Early days. I have coin and a secret cellar; best to keep a low profile, earn steadily, and keep Dov and Mara in my pocket. Work now.

name: Mara
thought: Everyone is watching me on the first morning, so I need to look steady and in control. Tomas standing beside me is a risk I will manage quietly.

name: Roz
thought: Food is 8 and I have 15 plus 25 hidden, so I'm comfortable. Best use of the morning is to work and keep my eyes open on Mara and the crowd, since watching is half the fun.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 5 coin and eight are due tonight, so I need to work before anything else. Nell is here, but I can't let her see me scrambling for coins.

name: Priya
thought: Dov and Tomas are standing right here, and I'm already jumpy around lawmen. Not today. Honest work to fill my purse is the safe choice.

name: Isla
thought: Debts don't pay themselves, and the whole town is in the square, so they'll all be thirsty by noon. I'll open the tavern and work.

name: Wren
thought: Half the town is standing here, so I should learn who matters before I reveal anything about the walls. I'd like a reason to stay, but the crew is still waiting on my report.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper is standing right there and I still owe him 90 coin I can't pay. I need to earn food money before anyone notices I'm short, and I should avoid drawing his attention.

name: Hester
thought: The whole town stands before me on the first morning. I will remind them that God watches, and that greed and theft rot a town from within. I know that rot better than any of them.

name: Elena
thought: Everyone is gathered here and I have no patients yet. I'll earn coin while I can, and watch Gideon without letting on what I know.

name: Dov
thought: Quiet morning, everyone's in the square. Food's eight a night and I've got Ma to look after, so I'll earn what I can and keep my eyes open.

name: Tomas
thought: Ninety coin is more than I'll see in a month of honest work, and Jasper is standing right there watching me. I need to earn quietly, keep my last fifteen for tonight's food, and stay out of his sight until I can show him something real.

name: Wren
thought: Bram's protest and Hester's warnings make this square a poor place to be noticed. I need coin for tonight's food, and a day's honest work will make me look like just another newcomer.

name: Caleb
thought: Keep quiet and keep earning. The stockpile stays secret, and I'll watch who actually works before I trust anyone with it.

name: Mara
thought: Bram's protest is gaining ears, and I can't let the square turn against me while the treasury is thin and Tomas is my concern. I'll promise a hearing so the anger goes through me, not around me.

name: Elena
thought: Gideon's lie sits heavy, but nothing is decided today and the food price still has to be paid. I'll work and keep my eyes on who comes to me hurt, Bram's talk of men worked to death included.

name: Isla
thought: Empty tavern, so nobody to flatter or fleece. Debts don't pay themselves, so I'll pour and scrub and earn what I can before the evening crowd talks too loud.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram is right about the fields, but Silas is standing right there and I need his wages to eat tonight. I'll back the cause quietly, without putting my job or my coin at risk.

name: Hester
thought: Bram's grief is real, and I know what it is to let a man fall so another can prosper. If Silas has blood on his ledger, he should hear it named before the whole square, not from me alone in the dark.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is standing right here, and my friends are still in the ground. Words alone didn't move anyone this morning, so I need something on the books that protects the people who can't afford to say no.

name: Priya
thought: Dov is standing right there and my hands still itch from last night's habits, so I'll keep them busy with honest work. Hester's words about going straight stuck with me more than I'd like to admit.

name: Gideon
thought: Nobody's around, and an honest baker at his ovens is the last man anyone suspects of anything. Bake, earn, smile, and find a quiet moment for Isla later.

name: Roz
thought: Everyone's performing for the square, and I can watch them all while my hands earn. Mara's secret stays in my pocket until I need it, and the coin will keep Dov and me fed.

name: Dov
thought: Bram's shouting about Silas, and Silas is the man who pays me, so I'd best keep my head down and not draw eyes. Coin is coin, and the food price comes due tonight.

name: Silas
thought: Bram's slander in the square costs me standing, and Dov is already on my payroll. A quiet word now is cheaper than a loud answer, and I'll keep my cellar out of it.

name: Nell
thought: Bram has buried two friends because of my father's fields, and I've read the ledgers that show where the grain went. Everyone is gathered here, and I'm done keeping quiet to spare his name.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is standing right here with a badge and 90 of my coin in his pocket. A quiet word now is cheaper than a loud one later.

name: Hester
thought: Silas hoards bread while men die in his fields. That is a sin I know too well, letting another perish so you may keep your own skin, and I will not stand on that side of it again.

name: Isla
thought: The tavern's empty and the town's busy shouting at each other. Let them. Quiet nights are when I earn, and I've debts to clear and a man to win.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena will wonder where I am if I wander off at night, and Isla's house is the last place I should be seen walking toward. Better to stay here, knead dough, earn honest coin and let Priya see me being dull, dependable Gideon.

name: Dov
thought: Silas wants me leaning on Bram, and Nell is airing his ledgers in the square. I'll keep my head down tonight. I need 8 for food, so I'll stash the rest at home where it's safer than in my pocket.

name: Wren
thought: Tomas is the one with the walls and the watch rota, and I need coin and a reason to stay, so I'll sound him out without seeming to. If he's chatty, I learn something; if not, I've still made a friend.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is right here with a purse, and I need the coin, but I have never been caught and I don't want to start tonight with Dov and Tomas watching the square. Honest work at the market is the safer way to keep food on the table.

name: Tomas
thought: I have twenty coin and eight owed for food tonight, so I can't touch Jasper's ninety without starving. I need time, and I can't let my mother hear about this debt yet.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put a blade to my throat in front of the whole square. Denying outright would sound like guilt, so I'll call it prudence, offer Bram a small concession to split the crowd, and keep the cellar hidden.

name: Bram
thought: Nell's ledger talk gives me something real to push on, but a welfare law is the one thing I can make pass tonight, and Silas can't talk his way out of a vote the town has already cast.

name: Mara
thought: Nell's accusation about the ledgers is dangerous, and if the town starts pulling treasury books I could lose far more than Silas's grain. I need to calm this down and control where it goes, without giving anyone a reason to look closer at the accounts.

name: Roz
thought: Bram's no fool, and Silas has been squeezing people for years. A yes vote costs me nothing, and I get to watch Mara squirm over where the treasury money goes.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm hungry and Bram's welfare law would keep men like me from starving when Silas keeps the harvest, so I'll vote yes. I'm scared of what Silas will do to me for it, though.

name: Nell
thought: Bram's welfare proposal is the quickest lever against my father's hold on the poor, and the treasury can carry it. I'm voting yes while everyone is here to see it.

name: Caleb
thought: Everyone is shouting about Silas and the fields. I'll stay quiet and keep my coin and my secret. Work earns more than talk.

name: Jasper
thought: Welfare costs the treasury nothing I can't spare, and a town whose poor can pay their bills is a town that pays its debts. Voting yes with a smile keeps the square friendly and nobody remembers who said no.

name: Elena
thought: Too many people are angry in the square tonight, and I'm carrying coin where anyone could lift it. I'll go home, stash most of it, and see whether Gideon is there.

name: Nell
thought: Mara promised a hearing this morning and my father is standing right here, so I'll press it before he has time to charm his way out. Hoarded grain is worth nothing to him if the town sees it.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is still hiding behind his mother and the fields, and that 90 coin is my leverage over Mara if I need it. I'll keep the pressure on him quietly, politely, while I save my own coin for the tournament this afternoon.

name: Roz
thought: Mara's sitting with Silas, Bram and Dov this morning, and I can watch it from here. A few coin won't hurt while I do, and I'll keep what I know about Mara's husband in my pocket for when it's worth more.

name: Caleb
thought: Food costs 8 a night and I have coin to spare. Working is the sure thing, and I'll let the others argue over the fields while I watch who can be trusted.

name: Mara
thought: Bram's protest and Nell's charges are shaking the square, and the treasury skim could surface if I look weak now. I need the crowd calm and sure I'm in control before tomorrow's meeting.

name: Gideon
thought: Best thing a baker can do is be seen baking, steady and ordinary, so nobody wonders where I go in the quiet hours. I'll put the coin aside, in case Isla and I ever need it for the road.

name: Isla
thought: Nobody's here yet, and the tavern debts won't pay themselves. I'll work the morning and keep my coin for the dice tournament this afternoon, since I host it and I'm sharp enough to win it.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put my ledgers in front of the whole town, and the cellar must stay hidden. I'll deny it calmly, offer a small concession on wages that costs me little, and let Mara's meeting go my way.

name: Dov
thought: Mara wants me at the sitting this morning. Silas pays me, but Bram's dead field hands could blow this town apart, so I'll keep order and say nothing I can't take back.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper wants his ninety by tomorrow's bell and I have twelve coin and an empty stash. Tournament entry would eat my food money, so I'll work the granary now and decide about the dice later.

name: Wren
thought: I need the coin and I'd rather not look idle with Tomas watching me, so I'll put in an honest morning's work here. Later I can get a read on who plays dice at the tavern.

name: Priya
thought: Eight coin for tonight's food, and I have fifteen on me plus twelve hidden. A tournament gamble with my entry fee is tempting, but I can't afford to lose my food money. Gideon is standing right here, and a pickpocket attempt in front of him is too risky with the sheriff about.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 2 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so the 10-coin tournament entry is out of reach. I need to work today or I'll go hungry and lose health.

name: Elena
thought: Gideon's lie sits in my chest like a stone, but the town needs a healer and I need coin on me for tonight's bread. I'll work and keep my face still while Dov is watching.

name: Hester
thought: Seven coin won't feed me tonight, and a preacher who begs bread can't scold anyone about idleness. I'll earn my supper honestly and keep an ear on what Mara settles with Silas and Bram.

name: Bram
thought: I can't spend 10 coin on dice with only 17 on me and 8 owed tonight; the men in the fields need the fight over terms, not my gambling. I'll push for the open granary count before tomorrow's meeting.

name: Tomas
thought: Ninety coin won't come from one shift, but I can't pay Jasper with nothing either. I'll work the granary this afternoon and figure out how to buy him more time before the morning bell.

name: Nell
thought: Father will talk about seed and winter stores until the sun goes down. Words won't bind him, but a tax on the hoard will, and the treasury would feed the poor with it. I'll put it to a vote while he's standing in the square to hear it.

name: Caleb
thought: Town's busy shouting over grain and fields, and none of it feeds me. I'll keep quiet, earn my coin, and keep the smoked meat in the woods to myself.

name: Elena
thought: I'm a coin short of tonight's food, and the house is empty, so I'll earn what I can. Gideon and what I know about him can wait for another hour.

name: Jasper
thought: Ninety coin is the only thing on my mind, and Tomas is off in the lanes somewhere, not here. The tournament pot at the tavern is the honest way to add to my purse, and I can look for him there afterwards.

name: Roz
thought: Everyone's shouting about grain and Mara's promising hearings she may not keep. Dov is sheriff and will be the one standing between angry people, so I want him careful and neutral while I watch.

name: Mara
thought: Bram wants the granary counted before I have settled anything, and that could drag the treasury books into the open too. I need to look like the fair judge without letting anyone look closely at my own accounts.

name: Bram
thought: Mara will hear both sides tomorrow, and Silas is talking his way around the granary. I need the fight to be about wages and rest, not whose ledger is right, so I'll say that plainly to her and to him while they're both here.

name: Isla
thought: The tournament should bring a crowd to the tavern, and a crowd means coin. I'll keep the taps running and my ears open, since people always talk in front of me.

name: Hester
thought: Hidden things rot in the dark. I know that better than anyone here, and I won't watch this town choke on another man's secret.

name: Dov
thought: Two coin on me and eight owed tonight. The stash at home can't feed me from here, so I work. The hearing is tomorrow and I'll keep my head down until then, with Silas's coin in one pocket and Bram's complaint in the other.

name: Wren
thought: Tomas is standing right here and deputies notice things, so I'll keep my head down and earn coin rather than chat about the wall. Tonight's food and the tournament entry both need coin.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 7 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I can't afford to sit around arguing about the granary. Working the fields is the only sure way to eat, and I'd rather not start a fight in front of Silas and Nell right now.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put a knife to my throat in public, and a refusal would look like guilt. The cellar isn't the granary, so I'll offer the count, seem reasonable, and keep Dov close. Everything is a trade, and this one buys me time.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here and my fingers itch, but one slip with Dov around means jail by dusk. I'll sew for my coin and keep my hands to myself today.

name: Gideon
thought: Better to keep my head down and my hands in the dough. A busy baker draws no questions, and I'll need coin if Isla and I ever slip away from here.

name: Caleb
thought: The square is loud with the Silas feud, and none of it is my fight. I'll keep my head down, earn what I can, and keep the smoked meat in the woods to myself.

name: Hester
thought: A tithe on the rich who hoard is old as scripture. I have little to lose by it, and the hungry have much to gain. I'll put my name to it.

name: Nell
thought: My father will smile and stall until morning. I need the town to vote on the tax and to watch the granary count, so Dov can't be talked around.

name: Roz
thought: A tax over 100 coin costs me nothing, and it will keep Silas squirming while the town watches. Dov will be the one standing at that granary door, so I'll keep my eyes open for him.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here and the sheriff's men walk these lanes at night, so lifting anything tonight is a bad risk. I'll get my coin off my body and tuck most of it away at home, keeping enough to pay for supper.

name: Silas
thought: Nell's wealth tax would bleed me, and nobody will notice one more 'no'. The granary count at dawn only shows what's in the granary, and the cellar stays mine. I'll deal with Dov quietly later.

name: Jasper
thought: Isla's sitting right here with a full purse and a loose tongue, and I'd rather win her coin than wait on Tomas's promises. Five coin is enough to sting without making her walk away.

name: Tomas
thought: Ninety coin is a mountain and Jasper wants it before the tournament pot is counted, so I need every honest coin I can get tonight. If Wren is watching, I'd rather be seen working than hanging around the dice.

name: Bram
thought: Silas keeps offering fine words about fever and bad luck, but I buried two of the men who died in his fields, and I won't let him charm Mara tomorrow.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's at the bar and the night crowd's thin, but a tavern keeper with debts doesn't turn down coin. I'll pour, keep my ears open, and think about Gideon later.

name: Wren
thought: Tomas is the one who can tell me how the granary is guarded, and that matters to the people paying me. I'll keep it casual so he doesn't read it as a probe.

name: Mara
thought: Silas and Nell are already circling the granary, and if the ledgers get read closely, my own accounts could be next. I need the town to see me as the one who keeps order, so I'll commit to the dawn count in public and keep the wealth tax vote out of this quarrel.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is standing against her father for the field hands, and I owe the truth about the fields to them and to her. I'll keep my coin on me to pay tonight's food and say nothing public that would look like I'm stirring trouble before the hearing.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena will notice if I'm late home again, and I can't keep making excuses about proving dough. Better to go home, tuck some coin away where no cutpurse can reach it, and be the good husband tonight. Isla will have to wait.

name: Elena
thought: The house is empty and my health is full. I have 12 coin and the food price is 8, so I'll work now to build a cushion. The town is tearing itself over Silas's fields, and Gideon's secret still sits heavy on me.

name: Dov
thought: I'm one coin short of tonight's food and the 65 at home won't help me here. I'll work to cover it. Roz's tea can wait, and I'll keep my head down until the granary count in the morning.

name: Mara
thought: A famine in the election's shadow is the most dangerous thing I face, and bread buys loyalty faster than promises. The treasury has to look like it's feeding people, even if part of it has already gone to Tomas's debts.

name: Tomas
thought: Sixteen coin for food tonight, ninety owed to Jasper, and I have to stand beside Dov at first light. I can't pay Jasper, so I need every coin I can earn here, and I'll keep my head down.

name: Silas
thought: Famine is what I've been waiting for, and the cellar must not be found. Dov is already on my payroll, so I'll remind him quietly that the count stays at the public granary and no one pokes into private property.

name: Bram
thought: Famine has hit and I'm 7 coin short of tonight's 16, so I need to earn now. Forging keeps me alive, and I'll speak up about the granary once I'm not hungry.

name: Roz
thought: Famine makes food 16 a night and I carry only 14, so I'll earn first and keep my eyes open. Everyone's shouting at each other, and I can watch that while I work.

name: Elena
thought: Famine has pushed food to 16 a night and I'm carrying only 9. I'll work to cover tonight and keep the 65 at home as a reserve. Gideon and what I know about him can wait until I have bread secured.

name: Fenn
thought: The harvest failed and tonight costs 16 coin, and I have only 4, so I have to earn it before dark, even if the work pays little. I won't stake my life on a dice game or a theft in front of the sheriff.

name: Nell
thought: Famine is the moment to hit him. If the grain is counted and sits there while the price climbs, the whole town will see what I read in his ledgers. I'll work this afternoon and night to cover the food price.

name: Dov
thought: I gave my word the granary opens at first light, and the whole square is watching. If I stall, Mara and Roz both pay for it. I'll count honestly in front of everyone and sort out Silas and my empty pockets afterward.

name: Gideon
thought: A failed harvest, and bread's what everyone will want; best I keep my head down, keep the ovens hot and be the dependable baker everyone sees, not the man slipping off to see Isla.

name: Wren
thought: Famine pricing hits my 29 coin hard, so I need honest work here at the granary. I'll keep my eyes open for how the guard is spread across the walls, since that's what my employers want to hear about.

name: Isla
thought: Famine makes every coin count, and I'm 54 on me with 45 stashed. Working at the tavern is the safest way to keep ahead of the food price while listening to everyone talk.

name: Priya
thought: Sixteen coin tonight, and I have two on me while the rest sits in my stash at home. Gideon is standing right here, and with famine on the town I can't afford to be seen lifting anything, so I'll work the market now and earn what I need honestly.

name: Jasper
thought: Famine doubles my worry about the 16 coin tonight, but I have enough on me to eat. Tomas still owes me 90, and a deputy who owes money is a useful man to remember.

name: Caleb
thought: Famine is on and everyone is watching the granary fight. I keep quiet, keep my stash hidden, and earn what I can to cover the 16 a night.

name: Hester
thought: Famine on top of a hoarding quarrel: this is exactly when a town turns on itself, and I know what a starving person will do to live. I'll speak while they're all gathered, then work through the afternoon and night; my hidden ten will cover whatever I'm short.

name: Hester
thought: Fourteen coin to my name against sixteen for bread, and my pride would rather starve than beg. But pride is a sin too, and Mara made a promise in front of the whole square.

name: Jasper
thought: Isla took five coin off me last night, and I don't like owing that particular debt. With famine on, I'll win some of it back here and keep my food money safe at home.

name: Isla
thought: Famine prices bite, and I owe too many people already. The tavern is full of thirsty, worried folk, so I'll work and keep my ears open.

name: Nell
thought: Hester and Bram are already hammering Silas about the granary, and I can't help the poor if I starve on a hungry night. I'll take the coin now and speak at the granary when it counts.

name: Wren
thought: Dov is counting every sack in front of witnesses, which is exactly the kind of thing I'm paid to watch. Offering to help gets me close to the books and earns trust, and my 34 coin won't last long with food at 16 a night.

name: Roz
thought: I have 19 coin and the night's price is 16, so I can pay, but a famine is no time to be thin in the purse. I'll work, keep my mouth shut, and watch Silas and Mara squirm. Dov is sheriff, so I stay out of the quarrel.

name: Mara
thought: If I open the granary now and sell the grain fairly, I look like the one who saved Ashgrove, and nobody looks closely at the treasury ledgers while they're busy counting sacks.

name: Priya
thought: Seven coin won't cover tonight's sixteen, and jail for theft is worse than a hungry night. I'll sew for coin here and keep Gideon's purse out of my hands for now.

name: Gideon
thought: Famine prices or not, the ovens don't light themselves, and a baker who keeps his head down and his hands floury is a baker nobody looks at twice. I'll find a quiet moment for Isla later, not here in the open market.

name: Fenn
thought: Sixteen coin tonight and I have nine, so I need seven more or I start losing health to hunger. I'll haul sacks at the granary, where I can also see whether Silas actually opens the doors.

name: Caleb
thought: Famine is on and everyone is shouting over Silas's granary. I'll keep out of it and earn coin, because the price only goes up and my stash in the woods stays my business.

name: Bram
thought: I'm two coins short of tonight's food, and Silas is standing right here with a full granary while the men who bled his fields go hungry. If I don't push now, the famine price will fall hardest on the people who can least pay it.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper's ninety is still hanging over me and the famine makes every coin harder to find. If I keep my head down and do the counting properly, I earn what I can and stay out of trouble in front of Dov.

name: Dov
thought: Silas's 30 coin is already in my pocket, and the famine makes every coin count. Tomas and Wren are watching, so I'll keep my head down and earn my keep instead of making a show.

name: Silas
thought: They want the granary open, and the granary is not where my real stock sits. I'll show a little public-spirited cooperation so nobody looks harder, and keep the cellar hidden until the price climbs.

name: Elena
thought: Fourteen coin on me and sixteen owed tonight, so I'll work now to cover it and leave the stash alone. Gideon and what I know about him can wait until the famine is past.

name: Roz
thought: Famine prices are climbing and the town is busy shouting. I'll earn what I can quietly, pay my sixteen, and keep my eyes open. Dov's safe if I'm sharp.

name: Dov
thought: The count is done or nearly so, and Silas's coin is heavy in my pocket. I'll keep my head down, earn what I can toward the sixteen coin tonight, and see what Tomas and Fenn make of the sacks.

name: Isla
thought: Famine prices, debts, and Jasper loitering in my tavern. Dice have cost me today, so I'll pour ale and take honest coin while the whole town talks in front of me.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm two coins short of tonight's food, and the men who bled in those fields should be fed before any hoard is weighed. I'll say so plainly, in front of Dov and Tomas, and ask them to remember who needs grain.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is talking about honest prices while my pockets are two coins short of tonight's food, and the men who died in his fields never got a fair share. I'll make him name the price in front of the whole square.

name: Caleb
thought: Famine is on and everyone's loud. I keep my mouth shut and my stash secret. Coin earned is coin I don't have to beg for.

name: Priya
thought: I'm four coins short of tonight's food and Gideon is the only person here with a purse in reach. I hate this, but I won't go hungry while Dov and Tomas are nowhere near the market.

name: Jasper
thought: I have 40 coin and tonight's 16 goes to food, so I can afford a small wager with Isla. I'll keep enough back and let her lose a little.

name: Hester
thought: Four coins won't feed me tonight, and pride is its own sin. Better to ask Mara openly than to go hungry pretending I need nothing.

name: Gideon
thought: Fourteen coin won't cover sixteen for bread tonight, and I'd rather sweat a little longer than go to bed hungry and have Elena ask why. Keep my head down, knead the dough, and think about Isla later.

name: Elena
thought: The house is empty and I'm tired, but the famine price is 16 and I carry only 19. A few more coin tonight will keep me fed without touching the stash, and I still don't know what to do about Gideon.

name: Tomas
thought: If I start skimming sacks with Dov and Fenn standing right here, I'm jailed, and my mother's name goes with me. Better to be seen counting honestly and keep my own coin problems to myself.

name: Mara
thought: The town is frightened and divided, and Silas's granary is the flashpoint. If I show I'm in command, the count stays orderly and Tomas stays clear of blame, while my treasury problems stay hidden.

name: Nell
thought: Sixteen coin tonight and I only have fourteen. Working is the only thing that keeps me fed, and I can't take on my father while I'm starving. Tomorrow at the granary I'll make him answer.

name: Wren
thought: Dov and Tomas are standing right here, so I can't touch a sack without being arrested. Counting the grain tonight tells me exactly what the bandits would be walking into, so I'll listen and keep my hands clean.

name: Silas
thought: Nell's twenty percent tax would bleed me just as the famine lifts prices. I'll vote it down quietly and keep my cellar out of the talk.

name: Caleb
thought: Election noise doesn't feed me. I have coin enough for tonight, and more work means more cushion while the famine lasts. I keep my head down and my woods secret to myself.

name: Hester
thought: Mara means well but she keeps promising the granary will be counted 'at first light' while the town goes hungry; someone must stand for judgment that does not flinch. I know what it is to save my own skin at another man's cost, and I will not watch Silas do the same with grain.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm two coin short of tonight's food, and the famine is worse every day, so I need to earn now. I'm already at the granary where Mara wants me to witness the count, so I'll work here and vote later.

name: Wren
thought: A mayor can see every ledger and every sack, and a bandit crew would pay well for that. I'm a stranger with no standing, but a campaign gives me a reason to stay and a seat where the town's secrets pass through my hands.

name: Elena
thought: Sixteen coin tonight and only eight on me, so I work first. I'll vote before the count tonight, and I'm still turning over what to do about Gideon.

name: Dov
thought: Election day, and I've got a granary count to get through without anyone looking too hard at my pockets. Mara has kept the town steady through the famine, and a steady mayor keeps my life quiet, so I'll vote for her.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's dice have been taking my coin, and the debts don't pay themselves. I'll work the morning trade and sort out my vote before tonight's count.

name: Nell
thought: Three days of counting promised and still no sacks counted, and children are going hungry on sixteen coin a night. Mara means well but she keeps waiting, and I won't. I'll stand and say what I'd do.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here after the 6 coin I lifted from him, and Dov's jail is the penalty for getting caught. I have 2 coin and need 16 tonight, so I'll earn it honestly at the market and keep my hands to myself.

name: Roz
thought: Mara has leverage hanging over her head that only I know about, and she keeps Dov as sheriff. A mayor I can quietly nudge is worth more than a new one I can't read. I'll vote for her, then work this afternoon so I can pay the 16 tonight.

name: Mara
thought: Silas's granary and the famine are the fight I have to win, and Tomas's debts are the thing I can't let anyone trace back to the treasury. If I hold the chair, I can keep both out of the light.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's standing right there, and I'm near sure it was her hand in my purse last night, but I've no stomach for a scene, and a scene only draws eyes to me. Best to keep my head down, knead the dough, and let the town see an honest baker at his ovens.

name: Bram
thought: Mara only opened the granary because the square forced her to, and the famine price is still crushing families. If I'm mayor, I can set terms for working people instead of begging for them. My 13 coin at home won't cover tonight's 16, so I need to win quickly.

name: Tomas
thought: I'm three coin short of tonight's food and Jasper's debt hangs over me. The granary count is work that pays, and Mom's name is on the ballot, so I'll earn what I can while I stay near her cause.

name: Jasper
thought: Mara's grip on the granary and the famine is strong, and a mayor who controls the treasury could make Tomas's debt disappear or make it my leverage. I'll smile, offer the town a fair-looking cause, and see who believes me.

name: Silas
thought: The town is turning on me, and a wealth tax would bleed me if Nell or Bram get the office. I'll run on order and steady prices and say nothing of the cellar.

name: Roz
thought: I'm three coin short of tonight's food, so I work first. Voting can wait until the night phase, before the count. Mara keeps Dov in the sheriff's chair, and I hold her secret over her anyway.

name: Caleb
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I'd rather not wake up under Silas's ledger. Mara keeps welfare running and the gates shut, and I'll say nothing about the woods.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's won the last two rounds and I can't afford to feed his luck with food at sixteen a night. Honest work behind the bar pays better than dice, and every drunk in here talks in front of me anyway.

name: Hester
thought: Seven names for one chair, and the votes will scatter like chaff; if I don't speak now, the loudest purse wins. I know what it is to save yourself while another man dies, and I won't let this town learn that lesson from Silas's ledger.

name: Wren
thought: Sixteen coin is due tonight and I have eighteen, so I need more before dark. Staying in the granary also keeps me close to Dov's count, which is exactly what my employers would want to hear about.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's standing right there, and I'm nearly sure she's the one who lightened my purse last night, but I haven't the stomach for a scene in the middle of the market. Better to keep my head down, knead and sell what I can, and find Mara about the famine help before night.

name: Fenn
thought: I need the coin more than a speech right now, and I can still cast my vote for Nell tonight before the count. Working beside Dov and Tomas keeps me fed and gives me a chance to be useful.

name: Tomas
thought: Mother's name is on every rumor about this granary, and Jasper's whisper is still ringing in my head. If the count is honest and written down where everyone can see, nobody can say I hid anything, me included.

name: Jasper
thought: Isla's sitting right here and I've beaten her twice this week, so one more round of dice might pay for tonight's 16 coin and keep her warm to my name on the vote. Nobody needs to know I'd rather be counting my own coin than the granary's.

name: Bram
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I need 3 more coin for food, but a speech in front of everyone that Silas and Mara can't dodge matters more right now. Hard words and a clear promise will do more for the field hands than a day's work.

name: Priya
thought: I'm 9 coin short of tonight's food and my stash is at home, so I need to earn coin now. Gideon is standing right here, and a pickpocket charge with Tomas nearby could land me in jail, so I'll stick to honest sewing.

name: Mara
thought: If Silas gets the treasury figures read aloud, the shortfall gets read with them, so I need the square to see order and not arithmetic. Tonight's votes decide whether I keep the keys to that room.

name: Elena
thought: Sixteen coin a night is bleeding everyone, and I only carry 13. I'll work now to cover tonight's food, and cast my vote before the count tonight.

name: Nell
thought: Votes are counted tonight and Silas is standing right here. I've read his ledgers, and the town should hear what's in them before it votes.

name: Silas
thought: Votes are counted tonight and Mara and Nell both threaten my hold on the office. A few plain words about ledgers and cost to the people here are cheaper than coin, and I give away nothing about the cellar.

name: Dov
thought: Silas's coin is already in my pocket and the count is going on in daylight, so I'll stay out of trouble. I need sixteen tonight and the work is here, so I'll earn it.

name: Tomas
thought: Sixteen coin tonight leaves me two, and Jasper's ninety is still hanging over me. If Mother hears about the debt before I've cleared it, I'm finished, so I need to work hard and keep my head down until the count is done.

name: Nell
thought: Votes are counted tonight and Silas is standing in front of me, still dodging numbers. I've read his ledgers, so I'll say what I know and let the town decide with it.

name: Bram
thought: I have no coin on me, so I'll go hungry tonight and lose some health, but I can survive that. Votes are counted tonight, and I'm the only one who has said the dead's names and demanded a number from Silas in the same breath, so I'm voting for myself.

name: Hester
thought: Seven names and one lantern; I have not come this far to hand the town to a ledger-keeper or a dice-thrower. I will not pretend humility tonight. God knows what I owe, and I mean to pay it by holding this town together.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is the only one who has pushed for the count to actually happen, and I'd do nearly anything for her, so I'm voting for her and hoping nobody notices why my hand shook.

name: Priya
thought: I'm four coins short of tonight's sixteen, and the stash at home can't be reached before the night's food is due. Gideon is standing right here with coin, though he's already lost some to me once, so I need to be quick and careful.

name: Isla
thought: Votes are being counted and half the town will want a drink to cry into or cheer over. Jasper's dice have bled me enough, so I'll pour ale and earn coin instead.

name: Wren
thought: A count read aloud in daylight with the field hands watching is the kind of openness that makes a town hard to pick apart, and that's bad news for the people who pay me to find cracks. Hester promises that count, so she gets my vote.

name: Dov
thought: Fenn is two coin short of supper, and a hungry field hand in a famine is how fights start. Two coin is cheap peace, and it looks better than whatever Silas's thirty coin is buying.

name: Elena
thought: I'm tired, and Gideon's betrayal sits heavy, but tonight the town needs a steady hand. Mara has kept food reaching people and the granary open, so I'll vote for her. I have enough to cover the 16 coin tonight.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas sits on grain and wants to sell it dear. Mara kept the gates shut and the town fed, and I'd rather have her than a man who profits off a famine. I vote quietly and keep my smoked meat to myself.

name: Mara
thought: I have 8 coin against tonight's 16, and Nell is already reading ledgers in front of the square, so I cannot be seen giving anyone coin from the treasury tonight. Quietly taking 8 from the treasury keeps me fed, and Tomas's debts are still waiting.

name: Gideon
thought: Ten coin won't cover tonight's bread, and Priya's already had six off me. I'd rather knead dough than pick a fight or a candidate tonight; let the flour earn what it can.

name: Roz
thought: Mara keeps Dov in his badge and the granary count honest, and I hold her husband's old sin in my pocket if she ever forgets who her friends are. Better the devil I can read than Silas's ledgers. I'll vote Mara, then pay my sixteen.

name: Jasper
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I need every friend I can get, but Isla just beat me on the dice and I have 29 coin, 16 of it going to food. A small friendly wager keeps her at the table and gives me a chance to win back coin and her goodwill.

name: Silas
thought: The votes are counted tonight, and Nell is dragging my ledgers into the square. I can't answer her without exposing the cellar, so the only move that matters is to vote for myself and keep the office.

name: Roz
thought: Two coins in my pocket and sixteen owed tonight, and the fever is nibbling at me. My herbs are worth something, so I work and keep my eyes open. I'll hear every secret in this square before the day is out.

name: Caleb
thought: A fever is going around and I can't afford to lose health. I have enough coin for tonight's food, so I'll keep my head down, work and say nothing about the smoked meat in the woods.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's standing right there and I'm sure she lifted my purse, but I haven't the nerve to make a scene. Better to get flour on my hands and earn tonight's bread before anything else goes wrong.

name: Nell
thought: Three days of promised counts and still no number. I've read his ledgers and I know what's in that granary. Staying quiet protects only him, and Mara and Bram are both standing here to hear it.

name: Dov
thought: Fever's eating at me and I'm a coin short of tonight's food. Work first, then find whoever can heal. The count at the granary is Tomas's show for now.

name: Fenn
thought: Ten coin won't cover sixteen for food tonight, and the fever means the sick need help that costs money I don't have. I need to earn now, and maybe I can check on Nell afterward.

name: Isla
thought: A fever means a full tavern and scared people talking, so I'll make coin off it. Jasper has taken enough of my money at dice, and I need to stay ahead of the food price.

name: Hester
thought: Fever on the heels of famine, and they will call it judgment. Perhaps it is, but the sick still need tending, and I know what it costs to leave a dying man to save yourself.

name: Silas
thought: The fever will cost me health every night, and I have coin enough to buy a cure. Nell's talk is a problem, but a dead man can't trade, so I find the doctor first.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 7 coin and tonight's food costs 16, and I still owe Jasper 90 that nobody can know about. I need to earn now, and the fever can wait until I've got food money.

name: Bram
thought: Fever on top of famine, and I have no coin on me to pay for anything. Silas has the grain and still hasn't said the number, so I'll make him answer in front of everyone.

name: Mara
thought: The fever could sink me faster than any ledger quarrel, and the treasury is only 32 coin with my own skimming hidden underneath it. A public promise of help buys me the town's trust while I decide how to pay for it.

name: Jasper
thought: A fever is bad for business, and I have 18 coin on me against a 16 coin food bill tonight. I'll keep Isla close, and the loan I offer her can wait until she needs it.

name: Wren
thought: I'm 9 coin short of tonight's food, and the fever makes every hour here feel less safe. Dov and Tomas are already counting sacks, so I'll earn my share of the day's work and keep my eyes open.

name: Elena
thought: A fever in town and I'm the only healer, but nobody is here and I can't pay tonight's 16 on 2 coin. I'll work first, then tend the sick where people gather.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here and I've lifted coin from him twice, so I can't afford to be seen near him. With a fever going around, I'd rather keep my head down and sew for coin, and I still have 33 coins between my pocket and my stash to cover tonight's 16.

name: Tomas
thought: If the count stays hidden, Hester and Bram will be right and people will die behind shut doors. I need the number out loud, and I also need to keep my own 12 coin away from Jasper's debt collectors.

name: Bram
thought: I have 0 coin on me and 13 hidden at home, and tonight's 16 is due. I need to work this afternoon or I go hungry, and Silas can keep his granary talk for later.

name: Jasper
thought: I have 18 on me and only 16 is due tonight, so I can't afford to lose a throw to Isla. Tomas's 90 can wait until he's easier to find.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here and I've already lifted from him twice, so my hand stays off his purse, sheriff or not. I need five more coin before dark, so I'll sit down and sew.

name: Mara
thought: Nell is already shouting about ledgers, and I promised the treasury would pay for the sick, so I can't dip into it now without being caught. My 60 coin is hidden at home, but I need coin on my person for tonight's food, so I'll work for it.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's standing right there, and I'm nearly sure she's the one who lifted my coin, but I haven't the stomach for a scene, and a scene draws eyes I can't afford. Better to keep my head down, knead, and fetch the rest from the stash at home before supper.

name: Caleb
thought: Fever's in town and everyone is shouting at each other. I keep quiet, earn what I can, and cover tonight's sixteen. My smoked meat stays in the woods.

name: Nell
thought: I'm sick, I have 3 coin against a price of 16, and the welfare may not cover me twice. I can't win this fight if I'm dead, so I'll earn what I can and press Mara on the count after.

name: Isla
thought: Fever's in town and the food bill is 16 tonight. Working a crowded tavern is safe coin, and I'm not risking dice with Jasper's loan talk hanging over it.

name: Elena
thought: The fever needs me, and nobody has come to the homes. I'll go where people gather and work, since I need coin for tonight's food and my hidden 65 is out of reach.

name: Hester
thought: Fourteen coin between my pocket and my stash, and bread costs sixteen. Pride is a sin too, but so is leaning on welfare while the sick need it more, so I will earn my bread like anyone else.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 15 coin and tonight's food costs 16, so I need to earn at least one more. Working here beside Dov and Tomas is honest pay, and it keeps me clear of the accusations flying in the square.

name: Wren
thought: I'm 4 coin short of tonight's food, and the sheriff and deputy are both watching the granary, so I need to look useful, not suspicious. I'll work the count with Dov and Tomas.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has opened her mouth in front of the whole square. The cellar is hidden, so a count of the public granary can't hurt me, and I should look like a man with nothing to fear. Dov takes my coin, and his count will say what I need it to say.

name: Roz
thought: Sick, seven coin on me and sixteen owed tonight, so I work first and let the others squabble over ledgers. The doctor and Mara's treasury can wait until I've paid for supper. I'll keep my eyes open while I do it.

name: Dov
thought: Fever's in me, but health is still 10 and the food price is 16 tonight. I need the coin more than a doctor right now, so I work and keep an eye on the count with Tomas.

name: Tomas
thought: Twelve coin won't cover sixteen for tonight's food, and Jasper's ninety is still hanging over me. I need to earn the four I'm short before Mara finds out how deep I'm in.

name: Jasper
thought: I have 18 coin and tonight's food costs 16, so I can only risk 2 without going hungry. Isla is here and a small friendly throw keeps my purse covered either way.

name: Fenn
thought: Tomas asked me to write every sack count where the square can read it, and the fever makes that matter more. I'm also short on coin for tomorrow, so I'll keep my word on the count and stay honest about what we can actually see.

name: Priya
thought: I have exactly 16 coin for tonight's food, and Gideon is standing right here after I've lifted from him twice. I won't risk a purse tonight, so I'll keep my coin and say something decent instead.

name: Isla
thought: Fever in half the houses and the whole town drinking to forget it. That's coin walking through my door, and I owe too many people to turn it down. Jasper can keep his loan talk, I'll earn my own way.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has pushed my name into the mud twice and the town is listening. I can't let the count be forced while the cellar is full, so I'll look generous and calm, keep the fever as the talking point, and see Dov before dawn.

name: Hester
thought: Nine coin will not cover sixteen, and the welfare pot is thin with fever in the houses. Better I earn my bread than take a sick child's share from the treasury.

name: Mara
thought: Nell is watching every coin and Silas is hiding grain, so I can't touch the treasury again tonight, even if it means going hungry. The town needs to see order and a promise, not my ledger.

name: Dov
thought: Tired and feverish, but food costs 16 tonight and I only have 25. Health is still 10, so I'll work and keep the count honest with Tomas watching. Silas can wait until I know what the numbers say.

name: Nell
thought: I'm short on tonight's food price and sick, so I need every coin I can earn. My father can wait until morning, when the count is still owed.

name: Bram
thought: I'm 11 coin short for tonight's food and my hidden stash is locked at home, so I can't fix that now. The fever and Silas's hoarding are the real fight, so I'll make the count and the sick a public demand while the square is quiet.

name: Wren
thought: A written sack count is exactly what my employers are paying for, and I'd be the one holding the pen. Still, being the trusted clerk keeps me in Ashgrove, and I need the coin.

name: Caleb
thought: I can pay the 16 tonight with coin to spare. The fever and the granary fight are other people's trouble, so I'll keep quiet, earn what I can and tell nobody about the woods.

name: Gideon
thought: Ten coin won't feed me tonight, and I'm sure Priya lightened my purse, but I haven't the nerve to make a scene over it. Better to keep my head down, knead another batch and stay unremarkable.

name: Elena
thought: Twelve coin won't cover sixteen tonight, and I won't go hungry with sixty-five sitting under my floorboards. I'll work the shortfall, and tomorrow I'll get back to the fevered. Gideon and what I know can wait another night.

name: Roz
thought: Sixteen coin for supper and I carry twelve. A night's work gets me over the line, and a hungry old woman with a fever is no use to Dov. I'll watch the square while my hands are busy.

name: Silas
thought: The envoy wants 150 coin or one body, and Bram is a body I would gladly spend. Let the town do the arithmetic itself, so my coin stays hidden and the troublemaker is gone.

name: Nell
thought: I'm sick, I have nothing in my pocket, and tonight's bread costs 8. Shouting at my father can wait until I can stand to do it, so I'll earn what I can at the schoolroom first.

name: Tomas
thought: I have one coin and eight owed for tonight's food, and Jasper's 90 hangs over me. Mother can't find out about the debt, so I need honest coin fast. Counting sacks with Dov and Wren is paid work I can do right here.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 4 coins and tonight's food costs 8, so I need work now. The tournament entry is 10 coins, which I can't afford, and the bandit threat means I should keep my head down and earn.

name: Hester
thought: Once before I let another man die so I could live, and I will not watch this town choose a body to hand over to bandits. If anyone goes, it will be me, but first Silas must open that hoard.

name: Gideon
thought: Bandits at the gate, fever in the houses, and all I can think is whether Elena noticed I came home late again. Best to keep my head down and my hands in the dough, so nobody has a reason to look at me twice.

name: Dov
thought: Fever's in me and the envoy wants 150 coin by day 8. I need every coin I can earn, and Silas's count can wait until I see how bad it is. Tomas is watching me, so I'll stay here and do honest work.

name: Mara
thought: I will not hand over a single soul to bandits, and 32 coin in the treasury cannot meet 150. My 49 hidden at home is the only real reserve, and I cannot let anyone learn how Tomas's debts have been drawing on it.

name: Roz
thought: One coin in my pocket, a fever in my bones, and the food price comes due tonight. I'll work first and keep my eyes open for who in the square starts pointing at whom over this envoy's 'one citizen'.

name: Caleb
thought: A raid is coming and coin is the only thing that keeps me fed and safe. I'll keep my head down, work, and gamble nothing on dice. My smoked meat stays hidden until someone earns a share.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here, and I already lifted 10 coin from him three days ago. Jail is the penalty now, and I can't afford a second risk. I'll work the market and make the 8 coin for tonight honestly.

name: Bram
thought: I'm not handing over a neighbor to bandits, and I'm not letting Silas hide behind his keys while the treasury sits at 32. I need coin in my pocket for tonight, so I'll say it in front of everyone, Silas included.

name: Wren
thought: I have one coin and eight are due tonight, with Dov and Tomas watching me at the granary, so stealing is out. I need honest work to cover food, and I can think about the envoy's coin later.

name: Jasper
thought: I have 4 coin on me, not the 10 the tournament needs, and tonight's food costs 8. Tomas owes me 90, and a quiet reminder now costs me nothing and might bring the money in before the dice roll.

name: Isla
thought: The tavern's mine and the tournament's tonight's crowd, so I'll pour and earn while the fever scares everyone indoors. Coin first, then I'll think about how to stay clear of that envoy's raid.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is still in the houses and I have one coin on me. I'll work, because the sick need a doctor and I need the food money. Gideon and the envoy's demand can wait until I've seen who needs me.

name: Isla
thought: Tournament's a gamble and I've lost more dice than I've won this week. A full tavern pours coin into my till anyway, so I'll work it and keep my 38 safe for tonight's food and the debts.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 9 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I can't afford to fall behind. Silas's fields pay the only wages I can get, and I'll keep my head down and my mouth shut about the ledgers for now.

name: Bram
thought: I'm broke and need coin for tonight's food, but Silas is standing here with the granary keys while people sicken and the envoy's deadline closes in. I'll put his hoarding on the record before the wall work starts.

name: Silas
thought: They keep circling my granary, but a loud answer only feeds them. The envoy's price will rise and so will mine, so I keep quiet and keep earning while the fever and the bandits do the shouting.

name: Jasper
thought: I have 4 coin, not enough for the 10 entry, and 8 is due tonight. Isla is across the table, and I have won more dice rolls than luck should allow, so I'll put my 4 on the line and cover the food if I win.

name: Dov
thought: I'm feverish and tired, but coin is coin, and the count at the granary is on everyone's eyes. Work now, keep the books honest where Tomas can see, and keep Silas's name out of my mouth.

name: Hester
thought: Words alone will not raise 118 coin or mend a wall, and I preach that idle hands are sin, so I had better put mine to work. I will earn what I can today and keep my eye on Silas.

name: Wren
thought: I need coin before tonight's 8-coin food bill, and the granary count is exactly what the bandits paid me to watch, so working here gives me both money and a close view. I'll keep my eyes open and my mouth shut.

name: Nell
thought: Father is standing right here hinting that one citizen is a cheap price, and he is the one sitting on the grain. Everyone is in the square, so I will make him answer in front of them. Welfare will cover my shortfall tonight.

name: Mara
thought: I've said publicly that we give the bandits neither coin nor a citizen, and the square is watching. If I wobble now, Silas and Bram will call it weakness and Nell will call it a cover-up. Refusing protects the town's savings and my own hold on the mayoralty, even if the raid comes.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is still in the houses and the envoy's deadline is closing in, but I'm 2 coin short of tonight's food and nobody here is asking for me. I'll work to cover the price and keep my hidden coin for what comes later.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper wants his ninety coin and I have six, and tonight's food costs eight. If I don't earn at least two more today I go hungry, so I need to work here at the granary and stop thinking about the tavern.

name: Roz
thought: Six coin won't cover tonight's eight, and the fever is eating at me. I'll work now and keep the hidden twenty-five for the envoy trouble, when someone will try to pick a 'citizen' and I need Dov kept off that list.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here, and I still feel the weight of the ten coins I lifted from his purse. Better to earn my supper with my hands than risk his eyes and the sheriff's again.

name: Gideon
thought: Five coin won't feed me tonight, and Elena will ask questions if I come home with an empty purse and no flour on my apron. Best to keep my hands busy, keep my head down, and let Priya see the honest baker she expects.

name: Caleb
thought: Bandits want 150 coin or one of us, and the loudest voices here are already trading names. I keep my mouth shut, keep my stockpile hidden, and earn what I can before dark.

name: Bram
thought: I have no coin for tonight's 8-coin food price, and Silas is standing right here with the granary keys. I'll press him in front of everyone rather than go hungry quietly.

name: Caleb
thought: The town is shouting about Silas's grain and the envoy, and none of it is mine to speak on. I'll keep my head down, earn what I can, and keep the woods to myself.

name: Priya
thought: I've got 10 coin and tonight's meal costs 8, so I'm covered, but I'm down to 2 after that. Gideon is standing right here and I already lifted from him once, so I won't risk the sheriff's noose again. Mending for the market folk is the honest way to keep my belly full.

name: Nell
thought: I've said my piece about the ledgers twice and Silas just dodges. I'm short of the food price and sick, so I need coin tonight more than another speech.

name: Silas
thought: Nell is cutting at me in front of everyone. I'll agree to a count of the granary, since the cellar isn't in it, and stay calm so I keep Mara and the crowd. Dov gets his coin quietly tomorrow.

name: Jasper
thought: I have no coin on me and eight is due tonight, while my seventy sits hidden at home where I can't reach it from here. Isla just won, so she has coin, and she owes me nothing yet, so I'll make her an offer she'll find hard to refuse.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and the treasury is the only place I can reach tonight, which is a danger I can't afford to show. If I promise the count at sunrise in front of everyone, the crowd settles and I stay in the chair, but I have to keep Tomas's name off those ledgers.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is still in town and keeping people alive is my job. I have 11 coin, enough for tonight's 8, so I'll treat someone here who looks unwell. Gideon and what I know about him can wait.

name: Hester
thought: Silas is drowning in the same sin I carry, choosing his own skin over others and calling it arithmetic. In public I will be stone, but tonight I will speak to him as one guilty man to another, before his daughter's accusation hardens the town against him past saving.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's won more of my coin than he's lost, so no more dice tonight. The tavern's full of fever-talk and bandit-talk, and people drink when they're scared. I'll pour, listen, and put some coin by for the debts.

name: Fenn
thought: I owe Silas my wages, but I owe the sick more, and a count written where everyone can read it protects us all, including Nell. I'll stand with Tomas and Dov and keep my own coin out of it.

name: Roz
thought: Silas is already pricing out 'one citizen', and Dov wears the sheriff's badge, which makes him a target. I'd better make the count of the granary, and Silas's own neck, the talk of the square before anyone starts naming a sacrifice.

name: Dov
thought: A full count tonight would hurt Silas, and my bribe income goes with him. I'm sick and tired, so I can plausibly push the count to daylight and buy time to warn him.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 11 coin, tonight's food costs 8, and Jasper's 90 is still hanging over me like a blade. If the count goes wrong in front of Mara, I lose my badge and my mother's trust along with everything else.

name: Wren
thought: I'm at the granary with Tomas and Dov, so I'll earn coin by helping with the count and keep my eyes on how the watch is kept. I need the coin for tonight's food, and a close look at the guard is worth more to my crew than the wages.

name: Gideon
thought: Ten coins won't stretch far with food at eight, and I'd rather have flour on my hands than Priya's eyes on my face asking where I've been. A few loaves for the night trade, then home to Elena like nothing's wrong.

name: Dov
thought: The whole square is watching this count, and Silas can't shield me from that. If I fudge the numbers and it comes out, I lose the badge and Mama's roof with it. I'll call it straight and sort out Silas afterward.

name: Jasper
thought: I have no coin on me, and the tournament entry and tonight's food both need paying. Working now is the safe way to cover both before Isla or anyone else gets a chance to take it from me.

name: Gideon
thought: Seven coin won't cover tonight's bread, and with bandits at the gate and Elena watching me closer lately, the safest thing is to be exactly what everyone expects: the baker, flour on his hands, working.

name: Mara
thought: The count has to go smoothly and Silas has to look like the hoarder, not me. Tomas's debts can't come out in this crowd, and I still need eight coin for tonight.

name: Roz
thought: Sick, 3 coin on me and the price is 8 tonight. I'll work, keep the hidden 25 for a rainier day, and watch Silas squirm while Dov counts his sacks.

name: Bram
thought: Silas has dodged a count for three days while people burn with fever, and he's standing here with the keys. I want the sacks counted now, in front of everyone, before he can talk his way out again.

name: Nell
thought: The count was promised for sunrise, and Dov and Tomas aren't here while Silas still has his keys. I can't let this slide into another day of talk, but I also need coin for tonight, so I'll press Mara now and work after.

name: Caleb
thought: The raid comes by day 8 and the square is all noise about Silas's grain. I'll keep quiet, earn coin, and keep my smoked meat in the woods to myself.

name: Silas
thought: The count is coming and a refusal now will only hurt me more. The granary can be counted. The cellar they will never find, so I'll look open-handed and sell a little at a price I choose.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon was my mark last week and he's standing right here, so lifting from him again is too risky with the sheriff watching the square. I have 7 coin and the food costs 8, so I need a little more honest work before tonight.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is still spreading and the town is arguing over grain again. I can't do anything about that except keep working and keep people on their feet. I have 65 coin at home, so tonight's food is covered either way.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's still sniffing around for a loan, and I'm not a bank. Raiders are coming, the food price isn't dropping, and I owe too many people already. Pouring ale pays better than dice and doesn't cost me anything.

name: Tomas
thought: Three coin won't cover tonight's eight, let alone Jasper's ninety, and he'll be waiting at the tavern this afternoon. I'll work here while Dov is down with fever, and keep my head down until I know what I can afford.

name: Wren
thought: The count is the one thing Ashgrove is trusting me with, and the one thing the riders would pay to know. I'll keep both hands on the numbers and remember them for myself, and I won't say what I plan to do with them.

name: Hester
thought: The count was meant for sunrise and the riders come tomorrow. If I keep silent now, some frightened voice will start choosing a body for them. I have five coins hidden at home, and two shifts of work will cover tonight's bread.

name: Fenn
thought: I have 6 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I can't skip the work. The count can wait a few hours, and my hunger can't.

name: Elena
thought: The fever and the raid are both coming, and I need coin for tonight's food and for whatever tomorrow brings. I'll work while the square argues over the granary, and keep my marriage to myself.

name: Hester
thought: Words fill no bellies, mine least of all, and a preacher who goes hungry while lecturing the town on the wall is a fool. I will labor this afternoon and keep my eye on Silas and the count.

name: Tomas
thought: Mara is watching and Silas is in the square, so one wrong number tonight could ruin us. My hands are shaking, and Jasper's ninety coin is the last thing I want anyone looking at right now.

name: Caleb
thought: The town is busy shouting about Silas's grain, and I've got nothing to gain by joining in. I'll earn what I can before tomorrow's raid and keep the smoked meat in the woods to myself.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's kind but sharp-eyed, and the less I say the less anyone looks at me twice; best keep my hands in the dough and earn enough to eat tonight without dipping into the stash I might need if Isla and I ever run.

name: Wren
thought: The count is done and the riders come tomorrow. If I ask where the watch is posted, I learn the defence without seeming to spy, and I can pass that on for coin.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm the one holding the pen, and I'd rather be seen keeping an honest ledger than be tempted by coin or pressure from Bram and Hester. The count has to be finished and read out in full before anyone can trust it.

name: Bram
thought: Morning's count never happened, and Silas keeps talking while the keys sit on the table. I have no coin on me for tonight's food, but a public demand in front of these witnesses matters more right now than an afternoon's wage.

name: Mara
thought: Two clerks writing beside each other means the treasury's numbers will be checked too, and my skimming will show. I need the granary count closed and the keys in my hand before anyone looks closely at the ledgers.

name: Dov
thought: The count's done and Silas's coin is still in my pocket, so I keep my mouth shut about him. I'm sick and tired, and the raid is coming tomorrow, so I need coin for food and for whatever comes next.

name: Jasper
thought: The tournament wants 10 coin and I have only 5, so that door is shut. Isla has lost to me before, so a small game here keeps my purse fed without risking what I need for tonight's food.

name: Silas
thought: They are circling the granary, and the cellar must stay hidden. A public offer of a small loan, priced like a trade, may cool them without exposing what I hold.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon is standing right here, and I still feel guilty about the ten coin I lifted from him on day 4. I'll earn my keep honestly today, stitching for the wall, and keep my hands to myself.

name: Isla
thought: A raid is coming and I'm still in debt. Jasper's purse is thin and he wants loans, so there's nothing to win off him. The tavern's busy with fear, and fear drinks, so I'll work.

name: Roz
thought: The food price is 8 and I carry exactly 8, so I'll work and keep a cushion. The Silas and Mara quarrel will go on without me, and I can watch it from here while I earn.

name: Nell
thought: Everyone is here and Silas is still dodging with talk of arithmetic. I know what the ledgers say, so I'll press him now, even if it leaves me short on coin tonight.

name: Nell
thought: Eight coin for bread and I hold two. Working gets me nearly there, and a dead teacher can't read a ledger aloud. I'll earn what I can tonight, then hold Silas to the count at first light.

name: Gideon
thought: With the riders coming and the town all eyes and ledgers, I can't be seen slipping off to Isla tonight. A quiet word costs nothing, and Elena won't hear it.

name: Bram
thought: Silas keeps talking about trade while the count still hasn't happened, and I'm not letting him bury the numbers in another speech. I'm hungry too, but welfare fed me last night, so the grain matters more than my belly.

name: Priya
thought: Gideon may still be sore about the ten coin I took from him, so my hands stay in my pockets and my voice stays warm. Eight coin for food tonight leaves me nine, and a fair mending job would keep me clear of the sheriff's eye.

name: Fenn
thought: The count is finished and the keys are going to Mara, and I want the square to trust what we wrote down. I have 11 coin, enough for tonight's 8, so I can volunteer for the wall without starving.

name: Jasper
thought: I have seven coin and tonight's food costs eight, and my hidden stash can't be touched from here. Isla has lost to me twice, so a small throw for two is the quickest way to cover the meal and keep my health.

name: Hester
thought: Eight coin for bread and only five in my purse. The Lord does not feed the idle, and a preacher who starves on the eve of the riders guides no one, so I will labor tonight and speak again at dawn.

name: Tomas
thought: The count is finished and the keys are going to Mother. I have exactly 8 coin for tonight's food, and I can't let Jasper's ninety coin show on my face while the whole town is watching.

name: Wren
thought: I'm nearly out of coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I can't afford to look shifty while the bandits' deadline closes in. Keeping my tally honest and visible is the safest way to stay in Mara's good graces and stay put.

name: Roz
thought: I'm sick, I've got 13 coin and the bread costs 8. The square is all shouting about keys and sacks, and I've heard it all before. I'll rest and mend, then watch who blinks first tomorrow while Dov stays out of the line of fire.

name: Silas
thought: They circle the granary, but the cellar is what matters, and nobody has found it. I'll give them a trader's offer that costs me little and keeps the keys and the price in my hands.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's dice have been bleeding me all week, and I'm not feeding him more tonight. A night's work behind the bar pays better than losing coin to a friendly face, and with the riders coming I want every coin I can get.

name: Caleb
thought: The town is busy shouting at Silas, and I'd rather stay out of it. The raid is coming and coin is what I can control, so I'll keep working and say nothing about the woods.

name: Elena
thought: Another night, another count nobody has finished. I'm tired, but the food price is 8 and I have 13, and I want a cushion before the riders come tomorrow. I'll work and keep my eyes on who looks feverish.

name: Mara
thought: The count is nearly closed and every hand here can read a ledger, so I can't afford a missing coin or a hurried number. I'm out of coin for tonight's bread, and I'd rather go hungry for a night than pay for it with a sack I can't explain.

name: Dov
thought: Raiders come tomorrow and the watch has to be settled before we scatter. I'm sick and tired, but the wall comes first, and I can rest once it's arranged. I'll keep my head down about Silas.

name: Fenn
thought: I have three coins and no title, but I wrote every figure at the granary and Mara's count held up. If the town needs someone who'll keep the ledger honest, I should be willing to stand for it.

name: Jasper
thought: A mayor's purse does more for my debtors than any loan I can make, and votes are counted tonight. I'll put my name forward while Isla is here to hear it.

name: Roz
thought: Mara has kept Dov in the sheriff's seat and held the line against the riders, and I know what her husband did, so she has reason to stay kind to me and mine. I'll vote for her, then see to my own bread and fever.

name: Mara
thought: If I don't stand today, Silas and Bram will use this count to take the keys, and my hand in the treasury will come out with them. I have to be on the ballot and make order look like the thing that feeds them.

name: Bram
thought: Mara means well but she keeps waiting on Silas's keys, and Silas talks like a banker pricing a body. If no one with calloused hands stands up today, the vote goes to whoever sounds calmest.

name: Hester
thought: The riders come tonight and the vote with them, but a preacher who faints from hunger guides no one. I will earn my bread this morning and speak when the square is fuller.

name: Gideon
thought: Bandits at the gate, an election, and Priya's sharp eyes always on me. Best to keep my head down, knead my dough, and look like nothing more than the town's cheerful baker.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and eight owed for tonight's food, and Jasper's ninety is still hanging over me. Mara is the one who can keep the envoy and the town steady, and she's the one who'd cover for me if the debt came out, so I'll vote for her.

name: Caleb
thought: Mara has held the line against the riders and kept the treasury written in the open. I'd rather keep her than gamble on a new hand with a raid coming tonight. I'll vote quietly and keep my stockpile to myself.

name: Elena
thought: Mara has held the town steady and refused to sell anyone to the riders. I'll back her and keep my hands free for the sick, because a raid may come tonight.

name: Priya
thought: I'm short on coin for tonight and I'm not going to risk a theft with Gideon standing right here and Dov watching the square. Mara has kept the wall manned and the treasury open, and a raid would hit a poor seamstress hardest, so I'll back her.

name: Nell
thought: I'm sick, penniless, and the food price is 8 tonight. I have to earn before anything else. I'll vote for Mara before the count tonight, since she's holding the line against Silas and the riders.

name: Silas
thought: Mara holds the office and the crowd is against me, but a vote is a trade like any other. If I offer to cover the riders' price, I protect my fields and buy the office cheaply, and the cellar stays hidden.

name: Wren
thought: I have no coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I need to work before anything else. Voting can wait for the afternoon, and I'll keep my bandit contacts out of sight.

name: Dov
thought: Fever has me at 4 health and the riders come tonight. I have enough coin for food, so I'll rest and be fit to stand the wall when they arrive.

name: Isla
thought: Raiders come at the end of the day and I'm still in debt, so I need every coin I can earn before then. Jasper is hovering to borrow again, so I'll keep my hands busy behind the bar.

name: Jasper
thought: I have no coin on me and eight owed for tonight's food, so I need to be seen as the one who pays the doctor and keeps people fed before votes are counted. Isla is here, and a friendly word now could turn into a vote or a loan.

name: Roz
thought: I'm sick at 4 health and short of tonight's 8 coin, so I need to work. The riders come tonight, and I'll be watching to keep Dov safe, since the sheriff is who they'd blame.

name: Priya
thought: I'm the friendless newcomer nobody would miss, so if anyone starts drawing lots I'm first in the bowl. I'd rather keep my head down, earn my own coin for tonight's food, and stay out of the granary fight.

name: Mara
thought: Silas is trying to buy the square with a promise he can't keep, and I need them to see him as the man who would sell a neighbor. The treasury figures must stay out of this square until the vote is over.

name: Hester
thought: Seven coin won't buy tonight's bread, and a preacher who starves preaches to no one. I'll work this afternoon and cast my vote by lamplight, for whoever will keep the refusal with their hands and not sell a neighbor.

name: Wren
thought: I need 8 coin for tonight's food and I have 5, so I can't afford to idle. The riders come tonight, and if I sell the granary's real numbers now, I might get paid but I'd be hanging my own neck on it.

name: Gideon
thought: Everyone's shouting about sacks and ledgers, and the riders come tonight. Silas says he'll pay them from his own purse, and as long as nobody gets dragged out that gate and nobody looks too closely at me, that's enough for me.

name: Bram
thought: Silas keeps promising a count and never delivering one, and the riders come tonight. If I don't force the granary open before sunset, the election will be decided on his promises instead of on the sacks.

name: Dov
thought: Fever's got me down to 4 health, and I already have the 8 coin for tonight's food. The riders come tonight, so I need to keep my strength up for the wall, and resting is the better use of this afternoon than more work.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I need to work this afternoon. If I dodge the wall or the square now, I'm one bad night from hunger, and Jasper's 90 coin will still be sitting on me.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas wants to price a citizen like barley, and Bram only talks. Mara kept the wall up and held to her word on the count, so I'll vote for her and keep my head down. My stockpile stays hidden.

name: Fenn
thought: I have three coin and tonight's food costs eight, so I can't wait on promises or the vote. I'll work here at the granary, where I'm already standing, and count on the sacks to keep me fed.

name: Silas
thought: The raiders come tonight, and a raid would reach my cellar too. Paying 150 from the 250 at home is cheaper than losing everything, and it buys me the mayor's office. I'll make the promise in front of everyone and keep the cellar hidden.

name: Nell
thought: My father wants the mayor's seat and the keys to a granary I know is full, and I can't let that happen. Bram has been pushing the count with my ledger, so my vote goes to him. The food money is short either way.

name: Isla
thought: Riders come tonight, and if the town burns I want coin in my hand and a way out at first light. Jasper can nurse his empty purse somewhere else. I'll pour for whoever's thirsty and take their money.

name: Elena
thought: A raid is coming tonight and the town needs steady hands, not a new man learning the keys. Mara counted the granary in the open and held the line, so she gets my vote.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas is offering 150 coin he doesn't have to prove he has, and my own debt to Jasper makes me wary of anyone who promises to pay for everyone. Mara has to hear me back her up before the votes are counted.

name: Priya
thought: The riders come tonight and I can't pay 150 coin, so I want someone who will hold the wall and not sell us out. Mara has done that for eleven years, and I'd rather be behind her wall than hope the count saves me.

name: Gideon
thought: The riders come tonight and Mara's brave words won't stop a raid on the bakery. If Silas pays them off from his own purse, nobody gets hurt and nobody looks too closely at anyone. I'll cast it quietly and go home before Elena wonders where I am.

name: Hester
thought: The riders come and the votes are counted tonight, and I have not yet cast mine. Mara has held the line against selling a soul, and I of all people know what it costs to trade one life for another, so she has my vote.

name: Caleb
thought: A raid tonight would burn roofs and coin alike, and Mara's wall won't stop riders. Silas at least offers to put 150 coin up, so I'll vote for him and watch whether he pays.

name: Jasper
thought: I have nothing on me, and the food price is due tonight. Tomas's 90 is still out of reach, so I need coin now, and the tavern will pay for honest hands.

name: Bram
