thought: Votes close tonight and the riders may come with them, but Silas still has the keys and a purse he wants to buy his way out with. I'll say it plainly in front of everyone and leave the count to them.

name: Fenn
thought: After tonight's food I'll have nothing left, and tomorrow's meal depends on coin I earn now. The ledger is already checked, so I'll put my hands to work here at the granary.

name: Dov
thought: Fever has me at 4 health and I can pay tonight's 8 coin. Tomas has the wall, so the best I can do for the town and for Roz is stay alive and rest.

name: Elena
thought: Silas's purse is a promise and his granary count is still hidden. Mara has held this wall for eleven years and won't sell a neighbor, so she gets my vote. I keep my 10 coin for tonight's food.

name: Roz
thought: Sick, health 4, and I'll have 2 coin left after the food price. The town has talked itself hoarse, so I'll watch the vote and the riders from a bench and save my strength for Dov.

name: Silas
thought: Votes are counted tonight, and the mayor's office is what keeps the count of my cellar from ever being forced. I vote for myself and say nothing more about grain.

name: Isla
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I haven't cast mine. I won't hand the town to Jasper's loans or Silas's purse. Bram works the forge and wants the grain counted in the open, so he gets my vote. At first light I go to Gideon.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me for tonight's food, and the treasury is down to 16 with Tomas's debts still owed, so I can't reach for it again while Bram has his eyes on the sacks. Silas's purse-promise is the real threat, so I need the square to hear me before the votes are counted.

name: Nell
thought: Silas is trying to buy the mayor's seat with coin squeezed out of the hungry, and I'm the one who read the ledgers. I'm sick and short of coin for tonight's bread, but I can still say it plainly while they're all here.

name: Wren
thought: I'm the one the bandits paid to map Ashgrove's defences, and a town that looks busy and united is safer cover than one that suspects me. I'll vote for Mara, who has the wall and the ledger, so I keep my place here and can keep watching.

name: Elena
thought: The raid has left the town bleeding and Nell is dead. I have 65 coin hidden at home, so food is covered. I'll work now, tend whoever comes to me, and keep my own counsel about Gideon.

name: Silas
thought: Nell is dead, and grief is a debt I can't collect on. Health 2 and sick, and one more bad night could finish me, so I rest. I have the 20 coin for tonight's food and 250 hidden besides, and nothing to gain by speaking in a square that wants my grain counted.

name: Wren
thought: Nell's dead and the treasury is gone, and I'm the one in this town who knows the riders were watching. I have 2 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I keep my head down and earn what I can without drawing eyes.

name: Gideon
thought: Nell's dead and the whole town is raw and watching each other. Best thing a baker can do is keep his head down, knead dough, and look like the same old Gideon everyone trusts.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is dead and I can barely hold the sack steady, but I'm three coins short of tonight's food, and if I starve I can't do anything for her or for this town. I'll work through the grief.

name: Roz
thought: Two health, a cough that won't leave, and 8 coin owed at nightfall. Dov walks the wall tonight, so I can't afford to fall over before then. I'll work and pay the food price.

name: Caleb
thought: The raid took the treasury and Nell is dead. Talk won't feed anyone, so I'll keep my head down and earn coin. The smoked meat in the woods stays hidden.

name: Jasper
thought: Nell is dead and the town is frightened, which means people will borrow now and pay later. Isla is here, and I can offer to cover her short coin for a price she won't refuse.

name: Priya
thought: Nell is dead and the raid has the whole town rattled, so this is no time to dip into anyone's purse with Dov and Tomas watching the wall. I have 27 hidden, enough for tonight's 8, so I'll keep my head down and earn honest coin.

name: Isla
thought: The raid went bad, just as Gideon said it might, but a day of honest work still pays and Jasper is watching me, so I'll keep my head down and earn. I'll find Gideon once the tavern empties.

name: Hester
thought: Nell is dead, the girl who only wanted the sacks counted, and I preached refusal and kept my own skin whole again. I'll earn my bread honestly today and bury my sorrow in labor before I bury her in words tonight.

name: Dov
thought: Health is 2 and I'm sick, and the raid took the treasury. I only have 5 coin against tonight's 8, so I work now to cover food. I can rest later if the coin holds.

name: Bram
thought: Nell is dead, and she died trying to get the granary counted. Silas's hoarding is why we're starving, and I need to put that on record before I go to the forge and try to earn the 6 coin I'm short tonight.

name: Tomas
thought: Nell is dead and part of me blames the wall I was supposed to walk, while the other part is counting my 5 coins against tonight's 8. Jasper's 90 coin still sits on me like a stone, and Mother can't see my face shake.

name: Mara
thought: Nell is dead, and if the granary ledgers come out in the open, so do the treasury skims that pay Tomas's debts. I have to look like the one who protects this town while I decide how much of the truth I can afford to show.

name: Priya
thought: Nell's dead and the riders are close, and I've got a full night's food to cover. Sewing is the only honest coin I have, and a seamstress who's seen to be busy at the market is a seamstress nobody watches too closely.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is dead and I still have her last words to me in my head. I need the sacks counted now, not at sunrise, and I can't let my grief make me look like I'm just one more voice in the crowd.

name: Hester
thought: The girl died begging for bread while a man counted his sacks, and I have stood beside worse sins than his and said nothing. My purse can wait; these two should hear that grief must not turn into a mob at sunrise.

name: Caleb
thought: Day 9 of 10 and I'm fed and healthy. I'll keep my head down, earn what I can, and keep the stockpile quiet until someone earns a share. Tomorrow at sunrise I stand at the granary count, so I need to be rested and steady.

name: Jasper
thought: I have no coin on me and eight owed tonight, so I'll earn it now. Tomas can wait until he's less busy with the granary count.

name: Dov
thought: I'm sick and down to 2 health. I've got 10 on me and 65 stashed, so food is covered tonight. Tomorrow's count at sunrise matters more than a few coin, so I'll go home and rest to stay alive for it.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin and 8 owed tonight, and the granary gets counted at sunrise, so I need to be seen working and earning, not hiding my 25 at home. Bram and Silas are watching me closely.

name: Tomas
thought: Five coins won't cover tonight's eight, and Jasper's debt is still hanging over me. Mother is watching the square, so I keep my head down and earn what I can.

name: Silas
thought: Nell is dead, and the town will blame me for it. None of that matters if the sickness kills me first. I have 20 coin and tonight's food costs 8, so I can afford to rest and keep what health I have. The count at sunrise is a problem for tomorrow.

name: Wren
thought: The raid that killed Nell came from the crew I report to, and Bram is already looking hard at anyone who handled the granary ledger. I need the 8 coin for tonight's food without drawing more eyes, so I'll put in an honest afternoon's work here.

name: Bram
thought: I have no coin on me and tonight's food costs 8, so I need to work this afternoon. The granary count is tomorrow, and I want to be fed and standing for it.

name: Elena
thought: The raid left people hurt and I'm worn thin, but I need 8 coin on me tonight and have only 7. I'll work, then see who needs me after the burial.

name: Roz
thought: Two health and a fever, and tonight's bread costs eight against my seven. One honest afternoon's work covers it, and the rest of the town can keep arguing over sacks while I stay alive to watch the end of it.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper's 'fair interest' is a leash, and I've got enough debt already. I'll pour ale, earn my own coin, and keep my ears open while the whole town talks in front of me.

name: Gideon
thought: Nell's dead, the town is raw and watching everyone, and the last thing I need is anyone looking hard at me. I'll keep my head down and do what everyone expects of Gideon: bake, earn, and smile.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is dead and I never told her what she meant to me. I need to hold myself together long enough to make sure the count is honest at sunrise.

name: Caleb
thought: Nell's dead and the town is on edge. I keep my mouth shut, keep my stash in the woods to myself, and earn what I can before sunrise, when I'm supposed to stand at the count.

name: Silas
thought: Nell is dead and I have two health left. Bram's accusation will keep, and the count at sunrise is a problem for tomorrow. Tonight I need to pay the 8 coin, get away from the square and mend before anyone decides I'm worth less alive.

name: Hester
thought: Nell is in the ground because grown men counted sacks instead of feeding children, and I said fine words and did nothing more. I'll earn my bread honestly tonight so I owe no one, and at sunrise I'll stand at that granary count with my eyes open.

name: Dov
thought: Fever has me at 2 health and I can barely stand. I can cover tonight's 8 coin, and the stash at home is safe, so I'll rest and stay alive for the granary count at sunrise.

name: Wren
thought: Counting sacks by lamplight with the keys locked away is exactly the kind of thing that makes a town look weak to outsiders, and my employers would love to hear about it. I'd rather keep my head down and see who pushes hardest.

name: Roz
thought: I'm at 2 health and sick, and tonight's 8 coin leaves me 4, so I can eat. I'll go home, where it's quiet and the 25 coin is close, and rest. I'm no use to Dov or to the sunrise count if I'm dead, and I'll see more from the granary tomorrow than from a grave.

name: Elena
thought: The raid left people hurt and the town is raw with grief. I have 12 coin and the food price is 8, so I'll work and keep a little ahead. Gideon can wait; the living come first.

name: Jasper
thought: Eight coin for food and I've only got five on me, and my stash is locked away at home. Isla's sitting right here with her purse out, and I win more than luck should allow.

name: Mara
thought: I'm three coin short of tonight's food, and tomorrow's open count could expose what I've taken from the treasury. Tomas is the only one who can keep that count clean, and he's the one I have to protect.

name: Gideon
thought: Nell in the ground, riders gone with the treasury, and all I can think about is whether Isla is safe tonight. Best I keep my head down, knead the dough, and be the same dull baker everyone expects at sunrise.

name: Isla
thought: Jasper keeps circling with his loans, and I'll owe no one if I can help it. The tavern is full of loose talk tonight, so I'll pour, earn, and keep my ears open. At first light I go to the bakery's back door for Gideon.

name: Bram
thought: Nell is dead and Silas kept the sacks sealed. I'm short for tonight's food and can't work at night, but a tax on hoarders would make Silas pay for what he did, so I'll push that now.

name: Priya
thought: Nell's death has me shaken, and I've got 16 coin and a clean record tonight, so I'd rather be seen grieving with the others than be the one eyeing Gideon's purse. I'll tell Hester I'll be at the chapel and at the granary count.

name: Tomas
thought: Nell is dead and my hands are shaking. I have 10 coin, Jasper's 90 is still hanging over me, and if Mother finds out about the debt I'm finished. For now I need to stand with her and keep the town steady.

name: Fenn
thought: Three of the people I was counting on are in the ground, and Nell is gone too. I have 2 coin and tonight costs 8, so I need to work this morning and keep my eyes on Wren, who keeps pushing me toward the granary at night.

name: Mara
thought: Silas, Dov and Roz are all dead, and Tomas is the only one left standing at the wall. I need the square to trust him with it, and I need them looking at the granary, not at my hidden coin.

name: Tomas
thought: Dov, Silas and Roz are all dead, so the badge is mine now, and Jasper's 90 coin is still sitting on me like a stone. I have 2 coin and need 8 by night, so I have to work every hour I can.

name: Bram
thought: Silas, Dov and Roz are dead, and I'm at two health with five coin and food due tonight. If I don't eat, I die, so I have to work now and get the coin before I do anything about the granary.

name: Wren
thought: Three of the people who could have stopped the sacks being sealed are dead, and Fenn is watching me like she expects me to take a side. I'm short 4 coin for tonight's food, and the granary is where I can earn it and count what the envoy's crew would want to know.

name: Gideon
thought: Silas, Dov, Roz all taken by fever in one night. My hands won't stop shaking. The bread still has to be made, and if I stand at my ovens and smile like always, nobody looks at me twice.

name: Isla
thought: Last day, and the fever's taking half the town. Jasper circles like a vulture, so I'll keep my head down and pull pints. Coin in my pocket is what I walk out of this with.

name: Hester
thought: Three more dead of fever overnight, Dov among them, and the town has no sheriff and no coin. I can still eat tonight if I work later, but this morning the living need a word from me more than I need a coin.

name: Priya
thought: Three of them dead of fever before noon, and the sacks are still sealed. I can sew shrouds for the dead and earn my food for tonight, and keep my head down while Tomas is the only lawman left.

name: Elena
thought: Three dead of fever in one night, and Caleb sat with Roz at the end. If it's spreading, he's the likeliest to carry it, so I start with him. Gideon can wait; keeping people alive comes first.

name: Jasper
thought: Last day, the town is dying of fever, and Tomas still owes me 90. The tournament is the one place I can win coin fast, and Isla is right here to see it.

name: Caleb
thought: Last day and fever is taking people. I've got coin enough for tonight's food, so I'll work, stay quiet, and keep the smoked meat to myself.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas, Dov and Roz are dead, the north wall is mine now, and I have seven coin against tonight's eight. Jasper's ninety is a nightmare I can't solve today, so I just need to work and eat.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm one coin short of tonight's food, and Nell wanted the sacks counted in the open, so I'll earn what I can here and watch Wren closely.

name: Wren
thought: I was paid to learn how weak Ashgrove is, and a granary count with three dead and the sheriff's seat empty would tell the envoy plenty. I'd rather keep my head down, look useful, and see whether Tomas's guard holds before I sell anything.

name: Isla
thought: Last day, and Jasper is sitting here waiting for me to borrow from him. I'll keep my head down, pour drinks and take the coin I'm owed. I don't need his interest.

name: Elena
thought: Three died of fever in one night, and I can't tell who is carrying it next. I have coin enough at home, so I'll use this hour on the living instead of earning more. Caleb has been sitting with the dead and looks worn through.

name: Priya
thought: Three dead in one night and the fever is coming through the town. I've got 27 hidden and 13 on me, enough for tonight, but I don't want to be the one who carried it into somebody's house.

name: Jasper
thought: Two coin won't cover eight for tonight's food, and Isla is sitting right here with dice in her hand. I'll win the rest from her and keep the 58 safe at home for later.

name: Bram
thought: I have 2 health and I'm down to my last 10 coin, and sunrise may never come for any of us. If I wait for the count tomorrow, the people who need grain tonight will go hungry, so I have to push Mara now.

name: Mara
thought: Silas, Dov and Roz are dead, and Tomas is the only one I can still count on. I have no coin on me, and tonight's 8 coin for food has to come from my own labor, so I'll work this afternoon.

name: Gideon
thought: Four graves in two days, and all I can think about is Isla's face. If the fever can take Silas in one night, how many more nights am I going to spend pretending at Elena's table? I can't say it out loud, not here with Hester watching.

name: Caleb
thought: Ten days in and the fever is taking people. I keep my coin, my mouth shut and my stockpile hidden. Working is the safest way to cover tonight's food.

name: Hester
thought: Four graves in two days, and the Lord still asks that I eat tonight. I'll earn my bread honestly at these stalls, and tonight at the chapel I'll pray for the man I left behind all those years ago, and for Nell, Silas, Dov and Roz.

name: Tomas
thought: Mara is three coin short again and Bram is watching every hand, so I can't be seen hoarding. I need my last 8 for tonight's food, and every coin I owe Jasper is one more thing that could ruin me if it comes out. I'll give Mara what I can spare and keep exactly enough to eat.

name: Fenn
thought: Wren keeps pushing for a lamp in the granary at night, and that smells like a plan to take grain out of sight. I want the count done in the open, where people can see it.

name: Gideon
thought: Last night of a terrible week, and all I want is to be the baker everyone still smiles at, not the man with a secret Hester's sharp eyes might catch. Better to give them warm bread and kind words than give them any reason to look at me twice.

name: Bram
thought: Eight coin goes to tonight's food and I'll keep my last two, but I'm not waiting for sunrise while Silas's sacks sit sealed. Mara has to open the granary now, with people watching.

name: Hester
thought: It is the last night, and I have carried that man's face for thirty years. Priya carried buckets for strangers today. If I can tell anyone in this town, it is her.

name: Wren
thought: Last night in Ashgrove, with nine coins and a bandit crew waiting on my report. Fenn is pushing for a count now, and a spy should not be the one who wants the granary opened in the dark.

name: Mara
thought: If I keep the sacks sealed one more night, the square will hang me with my own ledger, and I am three coin short of tonight's food anyway. Open the granary now, feed the families first, and let my own count go on record before anyone asks where the treasury went.

name: Jasper
thought: I have no coin on me and eight is due tonight, so I need a win now. A tournament needs no stake, and winning it is what I came for.

name: Isla
thought: Gideon is finally offering the way out, and Jasper is two feet away listening to everything, so I keep it short. Yes, but not here and not in words anyone can use against us.

name: Priya
thought: Last night of the ten days and the fever is taking people. I've got 13 coin and the food price is 8, so I can spare a little. Hester is the one nursing the sick, and a pickpocket giving a bit back might be the closest I get to going straight.

name: Elena
thought: Three dead of fever in one night, and I'm the only one who can do anything about it. Caleb sat with Roz, so he's the likeliest to carry it. I keep my 9 coin for the food price and tend him.

name: Caleb
thought: Fever took three in a night and the town is shaking. I keep my mouth shut, my stockpile hidden, and my coin working. Nobody here has earned a share yet.
